scope: English guidance for an adult with their own personal Google account whose primary phone or usual second step is unavailable. Excludes managed accounts, child/representative recovery and detailed Advanced Protection recovery.

questions.prompt: Is this your own personal Google account, as an adult?

choices.label: It is a work, school or managed account
It is for a child or someone else

questions.help: This guide never asks for an email address, password, recovery code or identity document.

questions.prompt: Do you remember your Google password?
Is the account enrolled in Google Advanced Protection?
Which previously set-up sign-in option can you still access?

choices.label: A backup code I previously saved

questions.help: Select only an option you already have. Enter codes only on Google’s own sign-in pages.

outcomes.title: Check with your account administrator
outcomes.nextStep: Google notes that personal-account recovery steps may not work for work, school or other managed accounts. Check the official guidance and contact your administrator.
unresolved: Google determines which verification and recovery options are available.

outcomes.title: Use the official route for that account
outcomes.nextStep: This draft is limited to an adult recovering their own personal Google account. Open Google’s account help for the appropriate route.

outcomes.title: Confirm which account needs help
outcomes.nextStep: Check whether the account is personal or managed before choosing a recovery process. Use Google’s official account help if you are unsure.

outcomes.title: Use Google’s account recovery process
outcomes.nextStep: Follow Google’s recovery process and answer its ownership questions. Do not share passwords or verification codes with this site or a third-party recovery service.
unresolved: Google determines which verification and recovery options are available.

outcomes.title: Check Google’s Advanced Protection instructions
outcomes.nextStep: Use Google’s official second-step help for Advanced Protection before choosing a recovery method. This draft does not apply the ordinary backup-options branch to that account.
unresolved: Advanced Protection may require a different recovery route.

outcomes.title: Review which verification options you have
outcomes.nextStep: Open Google’s official second-step help to identify an option you previously set up. If none is available, follow its account recovery route.

outcomes.title: Try your available Google verification option
outcomes.nextStep: Google lists another phone already signed in as a possible second-step option. Use Google’s sign-in process to try it. Once you regain access, follow its lost-phone security instructions.
prerequisites: You remember the password and can access another phone already signed in.
